# berlin × kawe — Company Brain (standing strategy)

## Brand
- Always write **berlin × kawe** with the multiplication sign ×, lowercase one-line lockup.
- Theme: Berlin's beauty emerging from chaos.
- Visual: black bear in neon lime glass orb on black; UI is archival mono metadata on black.
- Instagram @berlinxkw — paused until the operating system is live; no posting automation in MVP.

## Growth thesis
1. Build a recognizable Berlin-native aesthetic before scaling reach.
2. Weekly experiments beat daily thrash; one primary metric per week.
3. Archive-first content: observations, coordinates, timestamps — density over hype.

## Current quarter goals
- Ship advisor portal + Company Brain (this system).
- Prepare content backlog for Instagram relaunch.
- Target 2k followers within 90 days post-launch.

## Metrics (important)
- Week metrics in seed.json are **demo placeholders** until the advisor saves live numbers on /portal/system (manual) or syncs Meta Graph API.
- Agents must read metricsProvenance from get_portal_state — never treat demo seed as real @berlinxkw growth.

messages.content: Week 37 close: engagement is healthy but reach is flat. I propose we double down on the Mitte observation format and cut generic skyline shots.
Agreed. Let's make Mitte the hero district for two more weeks.

decisions.text: Run Mitte as primary district narrative for two weeks; all new posts must include coordinate metadata block.

evaluation.notes: Engagement +0.4pp vs prior week; saves up 22%. Keep format, add Kreuzberg B-roll next.

decisions.text: Pause paid boost tests until archive dashboard UI ships (brand consistency).

evaluation.notes: Correct call — saved budget; organic reach still climbed with consistent visual system.
